title: Run order planning
summary: make one finished item visible to planning, give it a demand it cannot cover from stock, run MRP, and read the result — a planned supply chain covering the shortfall — in the Item Order Plan, in Planned Orders, and in the pegging tree.

tokens.v: One planned order plays two roles: it is supply on the parent's plan and demand on the component's, and the component's own plan has already answered it. Planned quantities equal the raw shortfall only when the item's ordering data imposes no lot-size rule; a minimum or a multiple changes the number before you see it.

sections.text: - A purchased component will not transfer without buy-from business partner data. The transfer fails and prints "Buy-from BP cannot be determined for item … ; neither valid Item - BP data is present, nor a BP is linked to Item Purchase Data." The fix is a row on the Item - Business Partner tab of the item's purchase data. Nothing in this guide's phases surfaces this, because a planned purchase order is generated happily without it — the gap only appears at transfer. Not documented for this release.
